items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: In the early years, when I did have a chance to play with Steve, he told me the same thing.

ctx.x: Well, Richard M. Jones was from around that neighborhood too, I think. Yeah. Did you ever know him? He was a piano player?

Richard John. I heard him. Miney, they called him. Miney, yeah, yeah, yeah. Well, he's, I think he's the way or could avoid me, but I heard him talk about it. Now, there's another fellow that I remember, since we were speaking about that, uh, I met, he, uh, he, uh, he, uh, like the late John Porter. He come from around, around Lecce, and also he had a pal of his, uh, David John. They came from out around that section, see? Sure. Like I said, like a lot of those fellows, they, they came here and they, like I said,…
